YOUR TABLE. YOUR GAME.

A companion for the climb.

Keep your physical board and pieces at the table. This website handles the question cards and a triangular pyramid die that rolls from 1 to 4.

  1. 01

    Build your deck

    Choose Elementary, Middle school, High school, or College. Pick Math, Computer Science, Science, or Engineering, then choose a course. Use All courses for a mixed deck. Courses change to suit the selected grade level.

  2. 02

    Take the challenge

    Draw a card, choose one answer, and check it. A correct answer unlocks one roll. After a wrong or revealed answer, draw another card.

  3. 03

    Roll, then move

    Roll the die and move your real piece using your board’s rules. Pass the device to the next player and draw again.

Want different rules? Turn on Free roll to use the die anytime. Cards don’t repeat until you’ve drawn every card in the selected deck. Each focused course has six cards.

Cards, settings, and session progress stay in this browser when storage is available. No accounts, camera, or player information required.

 A FRESH START

Start a new session?

This clears the current card, deck history, dice rolls, and session totals on this device. Your level, subject, course, and Free roll setting stay selected.
